records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: Net sales increased by 51% to $324,344,000 in the third quarter and by 7% to $821,519,000 for the nine months ended June 26, 2021 compared to the three and nine months ended June 27, 2020, respectively.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: Price increases had a marginal impact on results in the quarter as traffic and volume drove almost all of the sales decline compared to prior year.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: Sales to food service customers increased by 68% in the third quarter to $196,478,000 and by 12% to $526,226,000 for the nine months, compared to respective prior year periods.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: The increase in operating income was primarily due to the increase in sales which improved margin efficiencies and expense leverage.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: Operating income in our Food Service segment was $17,644,000 in the third quarter compared with an operating loss of $18,242,000 in the prior year quarter.
